study type: Secondary analysis of the control arm of a cluster-randomized trial
exposure: Level of health care setting (hospital, clinic, home)
cohort: The participants were women who delivered an infant with a birth weight less than the 5th percentile and were enrolled in the Maternal Newborn Health (MNH) Registry from 7 sites in 6 low and middle-income countries.
finding: The study reports an overall low utilization of antenatal corticosteroids among mothers of infants with a birth weight less than the 5th percentile in hospital and clinic deliveries across the low and middle-income countries.
cross-section timing: Data were collected between October 2011 and March 2014
birth_weight: Infants with a birth weight <5th percentile
